findings.title: Use of eval
findings.description: eval executes arbitrary code from a string. If any part of that string comes from input, it is remote code execution.
findings.recommendation: Replace eval at src/util.js:2 with JSON.parse, a safe expression parser, or explicit logic.

metadata.whyItMatters: If an attacker influences the evaluated string they can run code with the privileges of the application.

findings.title: Prototype pollution (lodash@4.17.15)
findings.description: Versions of lodash before the fix are vulnerable to prototype pollution via merge and zipObjectDeep.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade lodash from 4.17.15 to 4.17.19 or later.

findings.title: AWS access key committed to the repository
findings.description: An AWS access key id is hardcoded in source. Anyone with read access to the repository can use it.
findings.recommendation: Rotate the AWS key found at src/config.js:3, remove it from the file, and load it from an environment variable or a secret manager.

metadata.whyItMatters: Anyone who can read this repository can act as your AWS account with whatever permissions this key has.
